## Trusted by 74,000+ Businesses Worldwide

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does the 21-day trial work?

When you sign up, you instantly get access to the fully-loaded CRM for 21 days. We will email you when your trial expires. You can then select a plan and pay by credit card to continue using the product. If you choose not to continue, your account will be suspended.

Is my data safe?

At Freshworks, we take data security seriously. Our servers are hosted in a world-class data center that is protected by 24-hour surveillance and we ensure that our application is always up-to-date with the latest security patches.

What types of payment do you accept?

1. Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and American Express credit cards are accepted across currencies (American Express and Discover cards are not accepted for INR currency). 2. We accept check payments in USD currency and this applies only for US and Canada customers.

What is a bot session?

A bot session is any unique interaction between an end-user and a bot. On chat, all end-users to bot interactions in a day are counted as 1 bot session and lasts for a maximum of 24 hours. Only customer-facing AI bot features consume bot sessions while agent-facing AI features and bots don’t consume bot sessions.

Do I get free AI agent sessions?

We offer 500 sessions with all paid plans to try out chatbots. This is limited to once per account. Once exhausted, you can buy additional sessions based on your requirements.

How can I buy additional bot sessions? What’s the validity of the sessions?

You can purchase an unlimited number of bot sessions using the AI agent add-on. The validity of bot sessions aligns with your payment cycle. For example: If you choose to pay quarterly, your bot sessions will also expire quarterly.

Have any other questions?

If you have questions about Freshsales or the signup process, please email us at crm-support@freshworks.com and we will be glad to answer all your questions.
